full_page.content:
Page 73
June 2 Mrs. Helen Leah Sipkins - 52 - Jewiss - very serious gall-stone trouble. Operated on May 26 ..... Drs. fear cancer. 4th phoned "Bad news" ... Drs say ... Cancer ... we'll wait.
2 Thanks - Verdun see episcopel Apr. 23 (Mrs. Fay) Carey for work Lenox 8530
Mr. & Mrs. E. Card - middle aged lutheran - spinal trouble - Enrol- led To-night.
6th Baby Patricia Forster again - 3rd time - from May 26 - still living and physically well but nerveous and seemingly hopeless as to nerve and mind. Aug. Ist Wonderful! Hardly believable - Running all a- round the office - Entertaining the crowd.
Mary Brozowsk - 52 - Complication - tuomers, dropsey, etc fears operation - Enrolled.
Page 74
June 9 Mrs. Carrie Montreuil - 76 - Cancer on forehead .. Mother of 11 chil- dren - Enrolled To-day ..... 5. - missions.
John Wilson - 10 - serious heart-trouble. Drs. give very little hopes. Is inscribed To-night in Ser. Masses - has older brother a prisoner of war in Germany, who, however, seems quite content.
Patricia A. Grubbe - 21 - T.B. in Det. San. - operation of appendix last Thanksgiving; then other operations and finally ... badly run down.
Joseph V. Burns - 39 - serious hemoraging - rapidly losing strength. Drs baffled - Wife enrolls PP. Souls ... 5. and promises more frequent Communion if ...
13 Marguerite Foley - 14 - brain tuomer - prayer the only hope ... Mande O'Connor - 48 - Pt. Huron - T.B. Feared. . ..
Page 75 June
Mrs. Florence Diermeier - 27 - July ... in Kiefer's ... T.B. fears further operation. ...
Michael Bell - 7 - Kidney operation feared necessary .... Enrolled To- day. Father promises to go back to sacraments. Mother non Cath. Now in Mayo's
